purpose: preliminary duration/noise study; no CI pipeline and no actual regression variant
order: 8 randomized complete blocks; one of each duration in every block
user_selection: highest passing smoke level with zero failures, max observed node CPU <=75%, p95 latency <100 ms
measurement: linear interpolation of raw Prometheus Kepler cumulative package-energy counters at exact workload completion-window boundaries
primary_energy: node CPU package active + idle counter deltas; includes co-located generator and background host work
secondary_energy: Online Boutique pod package-energy attribution estimates
quality_gate: zero smoke failures, <=0.1% campaign failure rate, no missing/reset counters, no scrape gap >10.5s, complete boundary bracketing, duration drift <0.5s

analysis.cv: sample SD/mean across independent runs at each duration, bootstrap 95% intervals
analysis.aa: predefined pseudo labels by block: A,B,B,A,A,B,B,A; one-sided exact permutation test for a mean energy increase
analysis.simulation: exhaustive disjoint subset resampling from 8 baseline runs; scale pseudo candidate energies; conditional planning estimates only
analysis.reliability_target: 80% detection at <=5% false alarms; cannot certify this target without independent A/A and actual regression experiments
analysis.stability_screen: exploratory relative CV improvement <10% between consecutive duration doublings; uncertainty and nonmonotonicity reported
analysis.p95_energy: p95 of approximately 5-second interval energy/completed-request ratios, NOT p95 individual request energy

calibration_exclusion: All revision-1 smoke/campaign runs are retained in calibration_v1 and excluded a priori because of cutoff step/interpolation bias.
